content:
Let \(x\) be the number with all four.  
Inclusion-exclusion gives \(x \ge 15\).  
Also, the all-four group is contained in the AC group, so \(x \le 70\).

Thus the data only imply  
\[
15 \le x \le 70,
\]
so the exact number is not determined.

\boxed{\text{Not determined; it is at least }15\text{ and at most }70.}
